comments: a758c1fe: ;Skips down to the BEGIN tag after setting the necessary variables.

f6a58f3f: ;Sets the variables DIE (global root), DIC (global root), DP (file #),
 ;DL (length of data), DIEL (enforced data length), and DU (uptran root
 ;node). Also kills and quits if the zero node is null.

f626e98d: ;Stores the 11th piece of the zero node in DE(1) and DE(4). This
 ;piece likely contains data to be edited.

 ;contains data to be edited.

ea8b319b: ;Writes the data label at the current cursor position.
f58299fc: ;Quits after writing the data label.

62db112a: ;Writes the Y variable, outputs a newline if the current line
 ;position exceeds 45, and positions the cursor on the 9th column.

4d4e9b47: ;Checks if Y is longer than 19 characters, DV is null, and DV does
 ;not contain 'I'. If these conditions are met and DV contains 'F' or
 ;'K', it branches to the RW^DIR2 routine.

a55d479c: ;Writes '// ' if Y is not null, checks if DV is null and contains
 ;'I', and if the DE array has a value at the DQ subscript. If these
 ;conditions are met, it sets X to null and writes '(No Editing)'.

0998a466: ;Reads user input into X with a timeout specified by DTIME. If
 ;the read times out, it sets DTOUT to null and X to the '^' character,
 ;and produces a beep.
6355cd43: Return if called with no parameters
d9dcc5d8: Increment the DQ counter used to track nested calls
25b9a249: Transfer control to the routine or line label specified by DQ
c9598ac2: If the DE array entry for DQ is defined, go to the PR line label; otherwise do W and TR
cb83e0a3: If X is null: go to A if DV doesn't contain 'R', or go to X if DV doesn't exist or D'>0, or go to A
06011494: If X starts with '?', go to QS; if X contains '^', do D and go to ^DIE17
560eb2a5: If X is '@', do D and go to Z^DIE2

ff453040: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' and doesn't contain 'P', and the DUZ user has a value in ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB), set X to that value; if DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write '  ' followed by X

48a034c7: If DV exists, go to M^DIE17; if DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3; if DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P. Execute code from DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) if it exists. Set % to the text after the first ';_X_:' in DU, and Y to X. If % is not null and DIC("S") is defined, execute DIC("S"). If the result is true and DB(DQ) is undefined, write '  ' followed by %. Go to V.
6965e2c6: Check if input meets Screen conditions specified by DIC('S'). If it does not, quit.
320cb39b: Write any characters after the delimiter if DB(DQ) is undefined. Store the string before the delimiter in X.
626f6256: If DV contains 'P' (indicating a Pointer value), perform a Lookup using ^DIC and set X to the internal entry number. If X is negative, quit.
49c262bf: If DV does not contain 'N' (indicating a Numeric value), perform Data Validation using D. If the result has more than 24 decimal places, discard it.
3178dc4e: If the value is a Number with Computed Decimal Places, perform formatting: remove leading zeros, trailing decimal zeros, and convert to integer if no decimal portion.

b7873942: ;Branch to RD if X is true (not null) or else fall through.

d5b29385: ;Call STATUS^DGJTHLP to perform DIEFIRE status processing, call ^DIC to get input, kill DIC to reinitialize it, set DIC back to DIE for DIEFIRE processing, set X to internal entry number if Y is > 0, else kill X.
eb0189c7: Screen for Date/Time input.
9be46072: Standard Mumps code to accept user input. DG is likely an array used for date input. For more context, refer to the continuation at label OUT^DIE17.

256364b1: Set the 'DGJTUP' variable to 1.
